name: animated-radio-group
title: Animated Radio Group
description: Pick one option. Arrow keys, Home and End move the choice.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The selected radio and its dot take its primary colour; the selected card too when Card fill color is Accent.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: cardFillColor
props.label: Card fill color
props.description: Fill of the selected card: a muted tint or the solid accent. Needs Style set to Cards.

props.name: showIcon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Show the radio circle next to each label.

props.name: slideDot
props.label: Slide dot
props.description: The dot glides from the old choice to the new one. Needs Icon on, and not used by the Full look.

props.name: slideCard
props.label: Slide card
props.description: The card highlight glides between cards. Needs Style set to Cards.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: The radio squashes and springs back when picked. Needs Icon on.

props.name: appearance
props.label: Look
props.description: Radio look: an outline ring, a filled ring or one solid circle. Needs Icon on.

props.name: reorder
props.label: Drag to reorder
props.description: Drag options up and down to reorder them.

props.name: colorful
props.label: Colour per option
props.description: Use each option's own accent colour.
